wins.text: NIKE Running grew over 20% in Q3, serving as the proof-of-concept for the Sport Offense strategy across other categories
North America Q3 revenue grew 3% with wholesale up 11%; first time in 2 years that all channels in North America showed positive growth simultaneously (February inflection)
Nike Mind 001 sold out in all geographies; production doubled for next 2 seasons to meet demand from 2M+ consumers who signed up for 'notify me' on nike.com
Greater China inventory down mid-teens YoY with units down more than 20%; partner inventory also declined double digits, indicating meaningful marketplace cleanup progress

$230M severance charge in supply chain and technology expected to begin delivering cost benefits in fiscal '27, building through fiscal '28, with this quarter representing the largest expected financial impact

risks.text: Gross margins declined 130 bps to 40.2%, including a 300 bps headwind from higher U.S. tariffs in North America; North America gross margins specifically declined 360 bps despite nearly 650 bps of gross tariff impact

EMEA Q3 revenue down 7% with NIKE Direct down 13% and NIKE stores down 20%; elevated inventory expected to persist through Q4 due to weak Sportswear sell-through, higher promotions, and Middle East traffic disruption
Greater China Q3 revenue declined 10% with wholesale down 13% and NIKE Digital down 21%; marketplace cleanup actions expected to remain a revenue headwind throughout fiscal '27
Sportswear declined low double digits globally in Q3 and represents more than half of total portfolio; intentional classic franchise inventory removal created ~5-point headwind to reported results

Tariff environment remains uncertain; tariffs expected to be a material year-over-year gross margin headwind through Q1 fiscal '27, with macro volatility from Middle East disruption and rising oil prices adding further uncertainty

guidance_items.detail: Q4 FY26 revenue expected down 2%-4% reported; calendar year through end of 2026 expected down low-single digits, with North America modest growth offset by Greater China declines
Greater China expected down approximately 20% in Q4 FY26 due to reduced sell-in and accelerated marketplace cleanup actions
Q4 gross margin expected down approximately 25-75 bps, including 250 bps headwind from tariffs; gross margin expansion expected to begin in Q2 FY27
Earnings expected to be 'flattish' through end of calendar year 2026, with recovery setting up from Q2 FY27 onward; full-year and long-term guidance deferred to Investor Day in fall
Q4 SG&A expected flat to down slightly; other expense net of interest income expected to be $15M-$25M expense; full-year tax rate in low 20% range

analyst_concerns_not_in_prepared: D2C gross margin quality and profitability relative to wholesale channel growth
Whether turnaround delays are primarily internal execution failures vs. external macro/geographic headwinds
Specific sell-through rate assumptions embedded in the calendar-year revenue guidance
